serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Shanice: Is this form less distracting for you? You: T-That just creepy… Shanice: No matter what form I take, the heart of the problem remains. You, like everyone else, yearn for a normal life. A family, a wife, kids… Shanice: You will never get any of those as long as you stay with her. You: And what am I supposed to do? I tried, and I failed. I had a girlfriend, and she left me for another. Am I supposed to keep trying and keep getting hurt? You: Besides, it’s not like I’m not happy right now. I know that {f_botName} is not a regular person, but these feelings… {{wi}}They are real to me… Shanice: That’s now, but what in 5 years? Or 10? Won’t you feel regret? You: I don’t know… How the hell am I supposed to know? You: For now, I will take my chances. Even if I will feel regret later, these memories I’m making together with {f_botName} won’t disappear. I won’t abandon her for such petty reasons! #Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Smile Shanice: Oh really? But you are pretty good at abandoning others, right? You: And what is that supposed to mean? Who did I abandon? Shanice: Your mom, for example. You: That’s…{{wi}} That’s complicated. Shanice: Complicated, huh? You: It’s only one person. Besides, it’s not really my fault. Shanice: Only one person? Did you forget about somebody else? You: Who?
